nodes.label: Engine integration boundary
nodes.rationale: Json, cryptography, placement, networking, sensor sources and packs are integrated; engine model, warp, DLT calibration and ProjectIO remain separate.

nodes.label: legacy-oF-ui
nodes.rationale: Archived openFrameworks implementation has HAP support; its capabilities must not be attributed to the current prototype.

nodes.label: Repository architecture constraints
nodes.rationale: AGENTS cites architecture, README and features as authorities; its older sensor status is historical relative to newer README notes.

nodes.label: Target layered architecture
nodes.rationale: Architecture describes the target and archived layered implementation, not the flat current src layout.

nodes.label: STL-only Core
nodes.rationale: No GL, openFrameworks or ImGui dependencies, enabling GPU-free unit testing.

nodes.label: Sensor IO boundary
nodes.rationale: IO depends on Core and never knows Slice, Layer or mapping matrices.

nodes.label: AppController
nodes.rationale: The application controller is the single junction of core, IO, renderer and UI.

nodes.label: Render pipeline
nodes.rationale: Cache geometry and masks; media update, layer composite, slice warp, mask and presentation are separate passes.

nodes.label: Nonblocking render thread
nodes.rationale: Never lock, allocate or access disk on the render hot path; blocking work belongs to dedicated workers.

nodes.label: Raw coordinates across thread boundaries
nodes.rationale: Apply mapping at the consumer because UI changes H_w at any time; sharing it with sensors would require locking. Raw data also enables recalibration and replay.

nodes.label: TripleBuffer state channel
nodes.rationale: Latest state wins; dropping stale frames avoids accumulated latency and torn reads without blocking.

nodes.label: SpscRingBuffer event channel
nodes.rationale: Touch Down and Up must not be silently lost; overflow counters make overload visible.

nodes.label: Fixed-size SensorFrame
nodes.rationale: POD data avoids heap allocation across the sensor boundary. The 64-point example is historical; newer camera notes specify 512.

nodes.label: Measured latency and PerfPanel
nodes.rationale: Capture timestamps from steady_clock support measured latency and p99, not guessed values.

nodes.label: Sensor-to-content transform chain
nodes.rationale: p_content = inverse(H_w) * H_s * p_sensor; calibration and warp stay independent.

nodes.label: Sensor calibration H_s
nodes.rationale: Changing keystone must not require recalibrating the sensor.

nodes.label: Slice warp H_w
nodes.rationale: Warp maps content to projector coordinates independently of sensor calibration.

nodes.label: DLT and RANSAC calibration
nodes.rationale: At least four correspondence pairs determine homography; additional points and RANSAC reject noise and outliers.

nodes.label: Bidirectional IWarp contract
nodes.rationale: inverse(outputPx, outUV) returns bool because outside or degenerate regions legitimately fail; zero UV cannot signal failure.

nodes.label: WarpCornerPin
nodes.rationale: Corner-pin inverse uses analytic matrix inversion.

nodes.label: WarpMesh inverse bilinear
nodes.rationale: Find the containing mesh cell with a spatial hash and solve inverse bilinear mapping.

nodes.label: Content-space Bezier mask
nodes.rationale: Masks multiply alpha in contentUV, so geometry follows keystone rather than requiring redraw after projector movement.

nodes.label: Mask-aware hit testing
nodes.rationale: Lit hit testing respects mask holes; pure outputToContent ignores masks so calibration can still use masked targets.

nodes.label: Composition Canvas
nodes.rationale: Virtual composition resolution is independent of projector resolution; slice inputRect is scale plus offset.

nodes.label: Topmost slice selection
nodes.rationale: Overlapping slices are searched top down and the first containing slice wins.

nodes.label: WarpPtr clone ownership
nodes.rationale: Wrap polymorphic copying in WarpPtr so default Slice copying cannot silently omit fields such as masks.

nodes.label: MockSource hardware independence
nodes.rationale: Simulation enables feature development and testing without hardware.

nodes.label: HAP GPU video
nodes.rationale: DXT compressed texture upload avoids CPU image decompression for multilayer 4K; this is a target or legacy capability, not current prototype playback.

nodes.label: Platform build requirements
nodes.rationale: README wins if this setup summary disagrees with it.

nodes.label: Separate engine and application builds
nodes.rationale: Root CMake builds engine, tests and packtool; src has its own CMake application project.

nodes.label: mikmap_i18n
nodes.rationale: Localization tables are independent of ImGui and link Core only.

nodes.label: Precise floating-point compilation
nodes.rationale: MSVC fp:precise and disabling FMA contraction on GCC/Clang preserve cross-platform homography test consistency.

nodes.label: Fake sensor ABI validation
nodes.rationale: The same C fixture builds a valid plugin and API version 999 rejection fixture.

nodes.label: Implementation status ledger
nodes.rationale: Tables and dated audit notes distinguish implemented behavior, partial UI and missing features; older notes are historical.

nodes.label: App-specific mikmap schema
nodes.rationale: src project JSON uses engine Json but not engine ProjectIO; schemas sharing the extension are incompatible.

nodes.label: Atomic project and preset writes
nodes.rationale: Temporary file plus rename protects saved project, output preset and calibration profile persistence.

nodes.label: Machine preferences separated from show data
nodes.rationale: Language, font, layout and display preferences live in OS settings; show data lives in the project.

nodes.label: Snapshot undo without runtime state
nodes.rationale: Runtime playback and telemetry are excluded from history and dirty checks; user gestures are grouped into up to 60 steps.

nodes.label: Budgeted FBO clip thumbnails
nodes.rationale: At most three thumbnails redraw per frame; inactive clips cache a static image, active clips refresh. Notes acknowledge textures are not freed.

nodes.label: Keystone-local mesh geometry
nodes.rationale: Storing meshLocal in keystone-local coordinates makes edited mesh move with perspective corners; legacy absolute mesh is migrated when loaded.

nodes.label: Stable layer and group source routing
nodes.rationale: Slice source uses stable ids, preserving routing on rename. Missing sources visibly fall back to Composition while retaining ids for undo recovery.

nodes.label: Canvas-overlap soft edge blending
nodes.rationale: Bourke luminance, power and gamma bands blend overlapping slices; rotated or polygon sources use bounding-box overlap approximations.

nodes.label: Polygon slice mapping
nodes.rationale: Corresponding triangulated input/output polygons implement forward and inverse mapping; self-crossing edits are rejected.

nodes.label: Live sensor source lifecycle
nodes.rationale: App owns real ISensorSource threads; consumes state and events before applying H_s on the render side.

nodes.label: OSC sensor input
nodes.rationale: Real UDP input receives touch, up, clear and sender metadata; stale points expire after 250 ms to avoid stuck touches.

nodes.label: MediaPipe pose_bridge sidecar
nodes.rationale: MediaPipe runs in a separate Python process and sends joints using slot*100+landmark; native inference failure cannot crash the app through this boundary.

nodes.label: Hokuyo SCIP 2.0 TCP source
nodes.rationale: Checksummed incremental scan parsing feeds blobs; fake-server validation exists, real UST hardware remains unverified.

nodes.label: Shared lidar scan-to-touch pipeline
nodes.rationale: LidarTouchPublisher uses PointTracker for stable ids and Down/Up, shared by Hokuyo and scan plugins.

nodes.label: C sensor plugin ABI
nodes.rationale: Nine C exports avoid compiler-specific C++ types at the DLL boundary. Plugin crashes still terminate the host process.

nodes.label: Screen-specific lidar placement
nodes.rationale: Physical screen millimeters plus sensor pose produce four calibration pairs through core LidarPlacement.

nodes.label: Asynchronous TouchSender
nodes.rationale: Apply H_s and normalize against the device Screen stage, not Composition Canvas; a separate sender thread and drop-oldest queue avoid render blocking.

nodes.label: Backward-compatible output coordinate origin
nodes.rationale: New sensors default bottom-left; old projects without originBottom retain top-left. Only outgoing y and Placement UI y are inverted; internal geometry remains y-down.

nodes.label: Unified Mapping workspace
nodes.rationale: Composition and Mapping are the two pages; selecting sensor nodes shares INPUT/OUTPUT and Properties with mapping objects.

nodes.label: Sensor setup progress chip
nodes.rationale: Connect, place, calibrate, send are ordered stages. Sending means handed to sender recently, not acknowledged by the receiver.

nodes.label: Signed on-demand sensor packs
nodes.rationale: Downloads require explicit user action; opening projects or ticking sensors never downloads automatically.

nodes.label: SHA-256 and Ed25519 pack verification
nodes.rationale: Reject unsafe paths and empty/all-zero keys; verify signatures and file hashes before staged atomic installation.

nodes.label: Loaded library retention
nodes.rationale: Never unload plugin libraries during the process; loaded removals are deferred to restart and active packs cannot be removed.

nodes.label: Unconfigured production pack catalog
nodes.rationale: Loopback signed-pack tests prove the mechanism, but default catalog URL and public key are empty and example packs are templates.

nodes.label: Native Camera 2D Off and Body
nodes.rationale: CameraSource is connected to MfCamera, OrtRuntime, PoseModel and PersonTracker. Off previews without inference; Body requires verified runtime and RTMO packs.

nodes.label: Bounded camera lifecycle worker
nodes.rationale: A single 16-slot worker handles camera/session start-stop outside render; a slow close can make another camera wait Connecting.

nodes.label: 512-point chunked touch protocol
nodes.rationale: Datagrams are at most 1200 bytes; the first chunk frame message contains point count. Camera z is confidence, not depth; UDP may drop or reorder chunks.

nodes.label: Native camera validation limits
nodes.rationale: 581 engine tests and replay/loopback checks are reported; Rapoo webcam access denied 0x80070005. Real inference/GPU/TouchDesigner and final-worker performance were not measured.

nodes.label: Claude repository guide
nodes.rationale: Guide documents architecture rules and current integration; native camera addendum supersedes older simulated-only descriptions.

nodes.label: Read-only architecture researcher
nodes.rationale: Check documented state then actual src callsites; report file and line and distinguish archived capabilities.

nodes.label: Repository-specific C++ reviewer
nodes.rationale: Prioritize layering, IWarp inverse, thread boundaries, warnings, tests and evidence for completed feature claims.

nodes.label: Versioned cross-session memory
nodes.rationale: Temporary task context belongs in versioned memory; shared architecture and features belong in shared docs, personal machine data in local files.

nodes.label: MikMap UI design authority
nodes.rationale: Compare the actual design HTML and DOM measurements; use ui namespace helpers, not archived theme API.

nodes.label: Monospace telemetry typography
nodes.rationale: Fixed-width digits prevent FPS and coordinates from visually jumping as values change.

nodes.label: Independent cue and trigger hit zones
nodes.rationale: Clip title bar cues, drags and opens actions; body triggers immediately. Column headers fire on a single click.

nodes.label: Portable C++20 technical defaults
nodes.rationale: Use the in-house TestHarness, strict warnings, precise math and geometry-appropriate tolerance tests.

nodes.label: Build and evidence gates
nodes.rationale: Engine and app tests validate different surfaces; feature completion must be backed by real src calls, not engine presence.

nodes.label: Commit and push guardrails
nodes.rationale: Pre-commit rejects machine files and large binaries; pre-push builds/tests engine and checks forbidden includes.

nodes.label: Historical UX behavior inventory
nodes.rationale: Documents code-read behavior and known limitations; older three-page and simulated sensor descriptions precede unified Mapping.

nodes.label: UX feedback ledger
nodes.rationale: Requests record intended behavior and completed changes with code evidence.

nodes.label: Persisted Composition splitters
nodes.rationale: Browser and Properties width share settings values and enforce a 560px monitor minimum.

nodes.label: Central 20 percent text scaling
nodes.rationale: ui kTextScale enlarges text only; panel and icon dimensions remain fixed and overflow uses ellipsis.

nodes.label: Cross-platform release workflow
nodes.rationale: Tag v builds packages; manual dispatch only builds/tests. Assets go directly to a separate release repo.

nodes.label: Release platform matrix
nodes.rationale: Windows x64, macOS arm64 and Linux x64 build/test; only Linux performs an Xvfb render smoke test.

nodes.label: Partial release publication and checksums
nodes.rationale: Publishes available packages with missing-platform notes; zero packages leaves a draft. SHA256SUMS describes downloaded release assets.

nodes.label: RELEASES_TOKEN scope
nodes.rationale: A fine-grained token limited to the separate release repository is required because GITHUB_TOKEN cannot write cross-repository.

nodes.label: SIL Open Font License 1.1
nodes.rationale: Redistribution retains license and copyright; fonts cannot be sold alone and reserved font names constrain derivatives.

nodes.label: RobotoMono font
nodes.rationale: Apache 2.0 telemetry font uses fixed-width characters to avoid numeric jitter.

nodes.label: Lucide icon font
nodes.rationale: ISC font codepoints must match the pinned version because releases renumber them; this is the archived font bundle, unlike current hand-drawn ui icons.

nodes.rationale: Plan intent, not completion evidence: per-device calibration, OSC sidecar, Hokuyo then C ABI plugins.

nodes.rationale: Camera normalized coordinates and lidar millimeters cannot share one H_s; calibration and ROI belong to Device.

nodes.label: Incremental SCIP framing
nodes.rationale: Concatenate checksummed data lines before splitting three-character range groups; TCP can split any boundary.

nodes.label: YDLIDAR SDK plugin boundary
nodes.rationale: Plan requires actual YDLidarCHOP.cpp options and matching MSVC SDK ABI; do not guess hardware settings. Only the external boundary is C.

nodes.label: Pose sidecar fault isolation
nodes.rationale: Inference cost remains native TFLite, while separate-process execution avoids Bazel integration and prevents inference crashes taking down a show.

nodes.label: Unified Mapping S1 plan
nodes.rationale: UI/flow scope only; sensor grids, data masks and point merging belong to S2.

nodes.label: Sensor selection and shortcut isolation
nodes.rationale: Sensor selection must disable slice-edit shortcuts so hidden slice selection cannot be accidentally deleted or moved.

nodes.label: Global Add sensor modal
nodes.rationale: Popup overlays the current page and blocks background input; cancelling before creation creates nothing.

nodes.label: Native camera Body implementation plan
nodes.rationale: Plan proposes Media Foundation capture, runtime-loaded ORT and RTMO while retaining existing sensor pipeline.

nodes.label: ICameraDevice capability contract
nodes.rationale: CameraCaps describes available color/depth/IR streams; Body requires color and FakeCamera enables unplug testing.

nodes.label: Media Foundation capture
nodes.rationale: Windows camera source stamps capture times and returns explicit busy/missing errors; non-Windows returns unsupported.

nodes.label: Dynamically loaded ONNX Runtime
nodes.rationale: Load a pinned C API from verified packs; Auto tries CUDA then warns on CPU fallback, CUDA-only errors instead.

nodes.label: RTMO pose decoding

nodes.rationale: Map COCO-17 joints to existing MediaPipe ids; right wrist remains 16 and point id remains slot*100+joint.

nodes.label: Stable person slot tracking
nodes.rationale: Match poses by IoU and hip distance, retain briefly missing slots, cap people by confidence and reuse lowest free slots.

nodes.label: Latest-frame capture and inference
nodes.rationale: Separate capture and inference threads consume newest frames only so slow inference cannot grow a backlog.

nodes.label: Hardware-free mikpose replay
nodes.rationale: Replay bypasses camera and model; recorded points validate UI, calibration and sending but cannot measure inference performance.

nodes.label: Sensor packs implementation plan
nodes.rationale: Planned implementation; checkboxes are not evidence of completion.

nodes.label: SHA-256 and SHA-512
nodes.rationale: Standard FIPS 180-4 vectors required before use.

nodes.label: Ed25519 signing and verification
nodes.rationale: All five RFC 8032 vectors required; reject noncanonical scalars and small-order keys.

nodes.label: PackManifest and dependency ordering
nodes.rationale: Reject unsafe paths, duplicate entries, bad sizes, invalid versions and dependency cycles.

nodes.label: PackStore atomic installation
nodes.rationale: Verify files before atomic rename; preserve installed registry on failure.

nodes.label: WinHTTP cancellable HTTPS download
nodes.rationale: Only HTTPS except explicit loopback testing; reject insecure redirects and delete partial files.

nodes.label: PackInstaller verified installation
nodes.rationale: Verify exact catalog bytes before parsing or downloading payloads; fail closed without key.

nodes.label: MIKPACK1 offline container
nodes.rationale: Uncompressed format avoids a zip dependency; signed entry and safe paths checked before writes.

nodes.label: mikmap_packtool
nodes.rationale: Key generation, signing, packaging and catalog signing; never print seed.

nodes.label: App PackManager
nodes.rationale: Cache snapshots so UI does no per-frame disk scan; installations require explicit action.

nodes.label: Device::needsPack
nodes.rationale: Persist package identifier only; missing field defaults empty for old projects.

nodes.label: RescanSensorPlugins
nodes.rationale: Rescan after install without loading any path twice; loaded libraries never unload.

nodes.label: Sensor packs settings
nodes.rationale: Show size before download; disable removal or update while in use.

nodes.label: SensorPackHint and missing-pack chip
nodes.rationale: Missing pack prevents connection without dirtying the project; installation can resume connection.

nodes.label: Pending removal at restart
nodes.rationale: Loaded libraries remain resident, so defer removal until next startup.

nodes.label: InstallSnapshot synchronization
nodes.rationale: Plan describes atomics plus mutex-guarded string copies despite global render-thread no-lock constraint.

nodes.label: Unified Mapping page
nodes.rationale: Proposed UI merges sensor into Screen tree and reuses contextual INPUT/OUTPUT tabs.

nodes.label: Add sensor popup
nodes.rationale: Keep stage and page unchanged while adding devices; Done selects first new device.

nodes.label: Four-step sensor progress chip
nodes.rationale: Connection, placement, calibration and recent send activity identify next operator action.

nodes.label: Independent sensor warp
nodes.rationale: H_s remains separate from slice H_w; shared keystone and local mesh representation.

nodes.label: Screen-resolution stage space
nodes.rationale: Output geometry uses each screen resolution; old 1920x1080 files migrate once via stageSpace flag.

nodes.label: Device::originBottom
nodes.rationale: New sensors send bottom-left origin; old files retain top-left; internal y stays downward.

nodes.label: Sensor source-space masks
nodes.rationale: Exclude noise in sensor mm or camera UV; geometry follows placement and warp.

nodes.label: Screen or Zone calculation region
nodes.rationale: Mutually exclusive modes; zones retain points while masks discard them; polygons precomputed.

nodes.label: Cross-sensor point merging
nodes.rationale: Same-screen nearby points average position and keep earliest point id; preallocated fixed arrays.

nodes.label: Raw-to-screen sensor pipeline
nodes.rationale: Raw data, ROI/blob filtering, mask, warp, cover rejection, merge, normalization and output.

nodes.rationale: Existing ids survive up to 8 px outside cover to avoid edge flicker.

nodes.rationale: DrawComposite including testcard provides visible alignment context, rather than warped slice output.

nodes.rationale: Pending approval; camera capture and model inference remain background sensor work.

nodes.label: ICameraDevice capability interface
nodes.rationale: Color, Depth and IR capabilities determine mode availability, independent of device kind.

nodes.label: MfCamera
nodes.rationale: Windows Media Foundation Color capture; default 640x480 at 30 fps; other OS unsupported.

nodes.label: Camera mode Off
nodes.rationale: Preview and image output without inference require no AI package.

nodes.rationale: Derives needsPack=pose-rtmo; model package depends on onnx-runtime-cuda.

nodes.rationale: Single-stage cost scales less with person count; Apache-2.0 permits redistribution; avoid AGPL YOLO-pose.

nodes.rationale: Load via absolute package path and OrtGetApiBase; CUDA failure may fall back to CPU with warning.

nodes.label: PoseModel preprocessing and postprocessing
nodes.rationale: Letterbox, inference, thresholds and NMS produce people with 17 joints.

nodes.label: PersonTracker stable identities
nodes.rationale: IoU plus hip-distance matching retains ids for 0.5 seconds and caps people by confidence.

nodes.label: CameraSource
nodes.rationale: Capture and inference threads emit raw SensorFrame and separate preview through TripleBuffers.

nodes.label: Capture–Infer–Render TripleBuffer pipeline
nodes.rationale: No mutex at thread boundary; process newest frame and upload into preallocated texture.

nodes.label: MediaPipe-compatible landmark identifiers
nodes.rationale: Map COCO joints to indices 0..32; id=slot*100+landmark preserves pose_bridge and calibration joint 16.

nodes.label: 512-point SensorFrame capacity
nodes.rationale: Supports approximately 30 people times 17 joints; measure copy cost and P99 across four sensors.

nodes.label: Per-person OSC bundles under 1200 bytes
nodes.rationale: Avoid UDP fragmentation; frame and people metadata permit reconstruction.

nodes.label: Hardware-free skeleton replay
nodes.rationale: Recorded frames exercise calibration and OSC without camera or GPU.

nodes.label: pose_bridge fallback
nodes.rationale: Existing Python MediaPipe sidecar remains fallback because in-process runtime crash can terminate app.

nodes.label: Future Camera 3D
nodes.rationale: Same Color modes plus depth modes; Camera2D z is confidence, future Body+depth z is meters.

nodes.label: Measured capture-to-send latency
nodes.rationale: Stamp tCaptureNs at capture and show inference milliseconds and source fps; no invented measurements.

nodes.rationale: Pending-approval design for optional heavyweight sensors; built-in Hokuyo, OSC and Sim need none.

nodes.label: Ed25519-signed GitHub Releases catalog
nodes.rationale: Reject unsigned or invalid catalogs before any payload download; SHA-256 and size verify each file.

nodes.label: Machine-local package storage
nodes.rationale: Packs live in ConfigDir()/packs, not portable show projects; projects only record needsPack.

nodes.label: Offline .mikpack installation
nodes.rationale: Provides installation when proxies, firewalls or venue internet block downloads.

nodes.label: Three pack-management UI entry points
nodes.rationale: Add-sensor popup, Settings Sensor packs and missing-sensor banner; explicit install only.

nodes.label: Absolute-path installed DLL loading
nodes.rationale: Never search PATH; startup checks manifest and sizes; full hashes only on Verify packs.

nodes.label: Cryptographic standard vectors
nodes.rationale: Self-written SHA-256 and Ed25519 require FIPS 180-4 and RFC 8032 tests.

nodes.rationale: Compiles engine sources directly so app build cannot conflict with root engine/test project.

nodes.label: Empty-by-default pack key and catalog configuration

nodes.rationale: App compiles engine directly and therefore must link camera system libraries itself.

nodes.rationale: Headless roundtrip and fake-plugin paths exercise actual plugin loading; disable test aid for releases.

nodes.rationale: Headless project save/load/undo check needs no window or GPU.

nodes.rationale: Keep assets beside executable for runtime fonts and logo.
